[Verse]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                        [ch]G[/ch]
There's a little mountain church in my thoughts of yesterday,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D[/ch]                                  [ch]A[/ch]
Where friends and family gathered for the Lord,[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]D[/ch]                                   [ch]G[/ch]
There an old fashioned preacher taught the straight and narrow way,[/tab]
[tab]                [ch]D[/ch]              [ch]A[/ch]             [ch]D[/ch]
For what few coins the congregation could afford,[/tab]
[tab]                                           [ch]G[/ch]
Dressed in all our Sunday best, we sat on pews of solid oak,[/tab]
[tab]         [ch]D[/ch]                               [ch]A[/ch]
And I remember how our voices filled the air,[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]D[/ch]                              [ch]G[/ch]
How mama sounded like an angel on those high soprano notes,[/tab]
[tab]              [ch]D[/ch]                 [ch]A[/ch]               [ch]D[/ch]
And when the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab]                                          [ch]G[/ch]
Looking back now, that little mountain church house,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D[/ch]                      [ch]A[/ch]
Has become my life's corner stone,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D[/ch]                              [ch]G[/ch]
It was there in that little mountain church house,[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]D[/ch]                    [ch]A[/ch]            [ch]D[/ch]
I first heard the word I've based my life upon.[/tab]

[Verse]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                   [ch]G[/ch]
At the all day Sunday singing, and dinner on the ground,[/tab]
[tab][ch]D[/ch]                                 [ch]A[/ch]
Many were the souls that were revived,[/tab]
[tab]           [ch]D[/ch]                                   [ch]G[/ch]
While my brothers and my sisters, who've gone on to glory land,[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]D[/ch]           [ch]A[/ch]             [ch]D[/ch]
Slept in peace in the maple grove nearby[/tab]

[Chorus] x2
[tab]                                          [ch]G[/ch]
Looking back now, that little mountain church house,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D[/ch]                      [ch]A[/ch]
Has become my life's corner stone,[/tab]
[tab]        [ch]D[/ch]                              [ch]G[/ch]
It was there in that little mountain church house,[/tab]
[tab]          [ch]D[/ch]                    [ch]A[/ch]            [ch]D[/ch]
I first heard the word I've based my life upon.[/tab]
